title: Quantum field quantities and compatible SI normalizations

items.title: Quantum field quantities and compatible SI normalizations
items.design_state: planned local unit and domain definition; complete SI consistency argument, model conventions, and scope boundaries authored
items.physical_scope: A unit and domain dictionary for selected quantum-field model data in four-dimensional Minkowski length coordinates. It declares engineering normalizations and conventions only; it constructs no field representation, QED dynamics, continuum limit, apparatus, or empirical result.
items.statement: Fixes the signature and length coordinates, symbolic SI/natural conversions, canonical engineering dimensions, SI-normalized photon and charge conventions, the first-variable-linear pairing, and a weak common-domain distribution convention. It asserts no field existence, pointwise products, self-adjoint closures, continuum QED construction, or empirical result.

items.title: Physical interpretation of a supplied constructed quantum model
items.design_state: planned adopted model-conditional Born interpretation; exact finite-instrument hypotheses and absence of continuum/empirical claims stated
items.physical_scope: Adopts state, finite instrument and actual constructed unitary dynamics only; supplies no missing continuum representation or convergence.
items.statement: Adopts the Born interpretation for a supplied density state and normalized finite bounded Kraus instrument, under the exact AC_omega hypothesis of the current QFT-MC03 lemma. Conditional updates apply only at positive probability. Supplied spectral projections require their own construction; no measurement result or continuum QFT construction is asserted.

items.title: Two-level measurement and formal-coefficient boundary
items.design_state: planned B leaf; complete finite two-level conditional argument and formal versus numerical convergence proof authored
items.physical_scope: Conditional ideal two-level instrument; no observed outcome and no formal coefficient identified as an exact probability.
items.statement: Constructs an explicit two-level state and normalized projective instrument, computes the conditional model probabilities and state updates, and proves that the formal factorial series has coefficients but radius of convergence zero. It reports no observation and assigns no probability to an isolated formal coefficient.
